title: RRB RADIOGRAPHER X-RAY TECHNICIAN Solved Papers & Practice Book 2025
author: Youth Competition Times
description: The RRB Radiographer and X-Ray Technician recruitment is one of the more specialised posts under Railway recruitment, and that specialisation cuts both ways. The competition pool is smaller than general RRB exams, but the technical questions are specific enough that generic science books will not carry you through. You need practice material built around what RRB actually asks Radiographer candidates — and that is exactly what this book delivers. Solved papers from previous RRB Radiographer and X-Ray Technician exams, plus full practice sets, all in English medium, across 224 focused pages.  The subject coverage maps to the actual RRB Radiographer syllabus. Anatomy and Physiology forms a core section — skeletal system including bones, joints, and anatomical landmarks used in radiographic positioning; the thoracic cavity and its organs; the abdomen and pelvis; the skull and facial bones; and the vertebral column. Radiographic Positioning and Techniques covers standard projections for every major body region — chest X-ray (PA, AP, lateral), upper limb (hand, wrist, forearm, elbow, humerus, shoulder), lower limb (foot, ankle, leg, knee, femur, hip), spine (cervical, thoracic, lumbar), skull and sinuses, and abdomen. Radiation Physics covers the nature of X-rays, production of X-rays in the X-ray tube, properties of X-rays, the electromagnetic spectrum, and units of radiation measurement. Radiographic Equipment covers X-ray tube construction, generators, image intensifiers, fluoroscopy basics, mobile and portable X-ray units, and dental X-ray equipment. Darkroom Technology and Image Processing covers film types, cassettes and intensifying screens, darkroom layout, manual and automatic processing, common processing errors, and digital radiography basics including CR and DR systems. Radiation Protection covers ALARA principles, protective devices, dose limits for workers and patients, radiation monitoring, and regulatory guidelines under the Atomic Energy Act. Patient Care covers infection control, patient positioning assistance, handling of trauma patients for X-ray, communication with patients, and emergency protocols in the radiology department. General Science and Aptitude sections cover Physics and Biology fundamentals, basic Mathematics, reasoning, and General Awareness relevant to the RRB exam pattern.  The practice sets at the end simulate the actual RRB exam pattern — the question distribution, the mix of technical and general sections, and the time pressure. Working through timed practice sets in the final weeks before your exam is a different kind of preparation from studying chapter notes, and this book gives you both in one place.  This book is written in English medium, which matches the medium most Radiography and Medical Imaging diploma and degree programmes use for their coursework. If you completed your B.Sc Radiology, Diploma in Medical Radiography, or B.Sc Medical Imaging Technology through English-medium instruction, this is the right edition for you. The technical terminology is accurate and consistent with what you would have studied during your programme.  The primary target exam is RRB Radiographer Group C recruitment under Indian Railways. Beyond Railways, this content is also directly useful for AIIMS Radiographer recruitment, ESIC X-Ray Technician posts, state health department Radiographer recruitment exams in states like UP, Rajasthan, Bihar, and MP, and defence radiographer posts under Army and Navy medical establishments. DSSSB Radiographer recruitment in Delhi also follows an overlapping technical syllabus.  Youth Competition Times produces exam-specific books for paramedical and technical railway posts that most larger publishers skip entirely. For a specialised post like RRB Radiographer, having a dedicated solved papers and practice book rather than trying to piece together preparation from general radiology textbooks makes a concrete difference to how efficiently you can prepare.  The PDF is clean and mobile-friendly. Anatomy and positioning content sometimes involves diagram-based questions, and the formatting handles those clearly enough to be readable on a standard phone screen. It works offline after download.  If the RRB Radiographer or X-Ray Technician post is your target, this is the most direct preparation tool available. Download it, start with the solved papers to understand the question pattern, then work through the practice sets timed. The technical depth is manageable if you have your radiography qualification — what this book adds is exam-specific practice.
